[Nr. 3]

Progress Tracking

Use weekly averages, not emotion. Measure weight, waist, strength performance, steps, sleep, and diet compliance.

Weight Daily Average

Measure every morning. Use weekly average, not single-day fluctuation.

Waist Weekly

If waist does not reduce for 14 days, reduce 150 kcal or add 2,000 steps.

Muscle 33 KG +

Keep protein high and progressive overload consistent to move muscle mass upward.

Sleep 7-8 HRS

Poor sleep slows fat loss and weakens training output.
